problem: The canonical Kata StatefulSet used /readyz for both readinessProbe and livenessProbe even though the ClayVerse application exposes /healthz as process liveness and /readyz as full runtime readiness. Temporary readiness loss could therefore trigger unnecessary full workload/microVM restart instead of remaining a readiness-only condition.

source_evidence.application_health_surface: the artefact/clayverse/terminal_gateway.py exposes /healthz for liveness and /readyz for runtime readiness

isolated_execution.scope: manually reconstructed focused MicroVM template/contract subset; not an exact full repository checkout

counterhypothesis: Using /readyz as liveness might intentionally force appliance restart whenever canonical runtime readiness is lost.
counterhypothesis_resolution: Rejected as the default deployment behavior because the application explicitly separates liveness (/healthz) from runtime readiness (/readyz), and the product recovery law distinguishes Tier-1/internal readiness recovery from Tier-2 full appliance restart when invariants cannot be trusted. A readiness-only failure is not itself proof that the process/appliance must be killed.
